parameters.name: reportId
parameters.label: Report
parameters.description: jfb_reports row id for this day

parameters.name: narrativeSections
parameters.label: Narrative sections
parameters.description: Caller-resolved ordered [{label, content}], one per configured jfb_project_report_narratives section for this project. Resolved client-side (not a domain-query source) because jfb_report_narratives_v2 has no sort_order of its own -- order lives on the separate template domain, joined by label.

parameters.name: dailyActivityByEquipment
parameters.label: Daily activity by equipment
parameters.description: Caller-resolved {equipmentId: [{num,from,to,minutes,area,pass,event,notes}]}. Resolved client-side because it needs timezone-aware calendar-day matching (jfb_daily_activities has no report_id/date column) and a two-hop delay-code lookup -- neither reachable from a domain-query filter or this engine's Handlebars (no eq/date-math helpers).

parameters.name: photoAssets
parameters.label: Photo assets
parameters.description: Caller-resolved {"1": {label, dataUri}|null, "2": {...}|null}, one per uploaded jfb_report_photos slot for this report. Resolved client-side via downloadAttachment() + base64 data-URI conversion, because the render engine's domain-query sources return only the photo_file_path file id, not file bytes, and the Asset Manifest only supports a fixed fileId set at publish time, not one that changes per report.
